Title: MemorySmith.Agent — AliasRegistry: Shared Item/Blueprint/Craft Alias Dictionaries
Content:
## Overview

AliasRegistry (Agent.Planning/AliasRegistry.cs) is a static class containing shared alias dictionaries for item, blueprint, and craft name resolution.

Consolidates previously-duplicated dictionaries in ChatInterpreter and IntentManager into a single source of truth (TSK-0099).

## ItemAliases

IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> (case-insensitive via StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase):
Maps common player shorthand and LLM-output names to canonical Minecraft item IDs.

Sources:
- ChatInterpreter: player shorthand (wood→oak_log, cobble→cobblestone, etc.)
- IntentManager: LLM output normalization (wool→white_wool, planks→oak_planks, etc.)

Key mappings include wood types (oak, birch, spruce, dark_oak, jungle, acacia, cherry, mangrove), stone types (cobblestone, stone_bricks), ores/items (coal, diamond, emerald, redstone, lapis_lazuli, iron_ore, gold_ore, copper_ore), terrain (dirt, sand, gravel, clay, snow_block), and utility items (wool→white_wool, planks→oak_planks, glass, chest, stick, etc.)

## BlueprintAliases

Maps common player-facing names to canonical blueprint IDs:
house, small house, cabin, shelter, hut, home, shack → small-house

## CraftAliases

Maps craft shorthand to canonical Minecraft item IDs for craft intent normalization:
Includes planks, sticks, chest, crafting_table, furnace, torch, tools (wooden/iron variants), armor, bread, bowl, sign, ladder, fence, door, trapdoor, slab, stairs.

## Fuzzy Matching (Sprint 57 TSK-0304)

TryResolve(name, out canonicalId) method:
1. Exact alias match (case-insensitive)
2. Fuzzy substring matching against Lazy<HashSet<string>> _knownItemIds
_knownItemIds contains all alias values + alias keys that look like valid IDs + additional common block IDs

## Usage

- IntentManager.ResolveItem: resolves item names before GoalRequest creation
- IntentManager.ResolveBlueprint: resolves blueprint aliases before BuildGoalRequest creation
- ChatInterpreter.ResolveCraftItem: uses CraftAliases for craft intent normalization
